title: What If You Just Keep Digging?

scenes.title: Ride down the hole
scenes.what: Flat 2D illustrated Earth cross-section (vector, grain texture); a little blue drill pod — the film's recurring vehicle — descends a shaft toward the glowing core.
scenes.motion: Slow continuous push-in down the shaft

scenes.title: How deep is deep?
scenes.what: Side cross-section: depth readouts in white heavy numerals with a lime dot pin (1.1KM → 3.5KM → 8.0KM) as the shaft grows; the Mariana Trench and Everest join for scale with lime caps tags.
scenes.motion: Camera trucks right as the number counts up; shaft extends linearly
scenes.type: White heavy numerals + lime pin; lime caps place tags

scenes.title: US vs USSR / Kola
scenes.what: Two shafts with flags and lime depth labels (182M vs 10M); Kola borehole drops to 12.2 KM with a white bracket.
scenes.motion: Bracket draws down; number pops
scenes.type: Lime numerals + small white caps unit

scenes.title: Fantasy core tropes
scenes.what: Cartoon tropes: a hero in the pod, a UFO, dinosaur fossils, 'WHAT'S REALLY GOING ON?' in lime stacked caps; the depth thermometer HUD appears at left.
scenes.motion: Quick gag cuts; text pops line by line

scenes.title: Drop, HUGE* title, crust
scenes.what: Pod lowered by a gantry ('DROP' button) into lava; borrowed cartoon cameo; HUGE* title sequence; '~40KM' crust depth with a long white bracket; Kola photo inset with '12,262M' caption; depth gauge fills.
scenes.motion: Mixed: title cuts every 3–6f; bracket draws; gauge fill linear
scenes.type: White heavy caps numbers; lime gauge readout

scenes.title: Email + document zoom
scenes.what: A recreated email from a scientist; camera pushes into scanned text where phrases get lime highlights ('moonshot').
scenes.motion: Slow push-in, depth-of-field blur on surrounding text, highlight wipes

scenes.title: THE MANTLE chapter
scenes.what: '.2%' lime stat beside a cut-away Earth with the pod badge; chapter card 'THE MANTLE' in fiery textured heavy caps on dark red; layer labels with lime dot pins (LITHOSPHERE, ASTHENOSPHERE); temperature '1300°C'; convection shown by big white curved arrows; depth gauge counting km.
scenes.motion: Chapter card hard cut; labels pop with leader lines; arrows animate along their curves
scenes.type: Fire-textured heavy caps chapter title; white caps layer labels with lime dots

scenes.title: Mantle convection
scenes.what: Convection cells as looping white arrows; the probe rides up and down; gauge readout keeps ticking (2,059 → 2,651 km).
scenes.motion: Arrows travel along loops (linear); counter ticks

scenes.title: Remote interview on paper
scenes.what: Two video-call panels in dark-teal frames on a cream paper board; tiny lime/teal dot pair top-left as a bullet.
scenes.motion: Panels hold; slight drift

scenes.title: Guest name pill
scenes.what: Single large framed guest with a rounded dark-teal pill caption at the bottom ('DR. MEGAN NEWCOMBE, GEOLOGIST AND VOLCANOLOGIST, UMD'); layout swaps between one and two panels.
scenes.motion: Panels resize and slide between layouts
scenes.type: White caps in a dark pill with lime keyline

scenes.title: Newton weighs the Earth
scenes.what: Portrait on graph paper beside an illustrated planet with formula; density arrows; dissolve to a cut-away Earth with 'THE CORE' lime label.
scenes.motion: Arrows pop inward; cross-dissolve

scenes.title: Seismic waves
scenes.what: Rays fan out from an earthquake through the planet; P-wave/S-wave diagram on dark board; seismograph traces scroll.
scenes.motion: Rays draw outward radially; waves propagate

scenes.title: S-wave shadow → OUTER CORE
scenes.what: Shadow zone forms (lime arc on the rim, 'S WAVE SHADOW'); dashed circle reveals 'OUTER CORE'; the pod dives in; '4,400° C' lime stat; MANTLE / OUTER CORE labels in the cross-section.
scenes.motion: Rays draw, arc grows, dashed circle draws, labels pop
scenes.type: Lime heavy caps; dark-red/yellow layer names

scenes.title: Magnetic field
scenes.what: Core with white field lines that grow around it, then solar-wind streaks bend around the field.
scenes.motion: Lines draw outward; streaks flow

scenes.title: Compass and flip
scenes.what: Blue/red field lines and a compass whose needle swings as the field flips.
scenes.motion: Needle rotates with ease-in-out; lines morph

scenes.title: Interview board
scenes.what: Two-panel interview on paper.
scenes.motion: Hold

scenes.title: Seafloor stripes + timeline
scenes.what: Spreading ridge block diagram with magma; interview; magnetic-reversal barcode timeline with era labels; stratigraphic column with lime arrows.
scenes.motion: Block extrudes; barcode pans
scenes.type: Small caps era labels; lime arrows

scenes.title: THE INNER CORE chapter
scenes.what: Layer stack legend (CRUST/UPPER MANTLE/LOWER MANTLE/OUTER CORE) with lime labels; iron rain; pod in molten yellow with gauge; fiery 'THE INNER CORE' chapter card; dark planet with red glow and '5,400° C' stat.
scenes.motion: Chapter hard cut; stat fades up
scenes.type: Fire-textured chapter caps; lime legend labels

scenes.title: Core ignites
scenes.what: Inner core turns from dark iron to glowing yellow.
scenes.motion: Colour cross-fade

scenes.title: How we know: paper cards
scenes.what: Rays bend through the core; diagram cards (scanned textbook figures) fan in from the right as a stack.
scenes.motion: Cards slide in and rotate slightly, stacking

scenes.title: Iron crystal magnifier
scenes.what: Lime dot on the inner core expands into a magnifier circle with a dark-teal cone showing an iron lattice.
scenes.motion: Circle scales from the dot, ease-out

scenes.title: Inner core rotation
scenes.what: Cut-away layers; the inner core spins with white curved rotation arrows.
scenes.motion: Loop rotation; arrows draw

scenes.title: Rotation data
scenes.what: Paper chart cards beside the spinning core; then a clean sine curve (blue→orange) with '~70 YEARS' period brackets.
scenes.motion: Cards slide; curve draws L→R

scenes.title: Headlines over the host
scenes.what: Headlines type over the host's side of the frame (white text with lime-highlighted key words), one after another.
scenes.motion: Each headline types/fades in ~0.6s, replaces the last
scenes.type: White serif/sans headline with lime key words

scenes.title: Welcome to the center
scenes.what: Orbit diagram with core labels; pod drills through yellow core with debris; gauge hits 6,000 km; 'WELCOME TO THE CENTER' white caps with red pressure arrows.
scenes.motion: Drill spin loop; arrows pulse inward

scenes.title: Depth recap
scenes.what: Readouts at 850 KM / 4,284 KM / 6,296 KM with lime dot pins as the camera dives; '?' inner core; Science News card with lime highlight.
scenes.motion: Numbers pop at each layer; headline card pops
scenes.type: Lime outlined numerals + white mi line

scenes.title: Field simulation
scenes.what: Borrowed 3D field-line simulation then the house compass diagram.
scenes.motion: Cut

scenes.title: Seismic simulation
scenes.what: Borrowed globe simulation with data panel.
scenes.motion: Cut

scenes.title: Pull back out
scenes.what: Zoom out from the core to the whole planet.
scenes.motion: Long pull-back, ease-in-out

scenes.title: Recap + end card
scenes.what: Gantry drop, convection, Cleo standing on the surface with the gauge at 0 m; HUGE* end card with credits.
scenes.motion: Quick recap cuts
